description.zh: 源自 agency-orchestrator 的 DAG 协作理念：把一句话需求拆成有依赖关系的步骤，匹配最合适的子智能体角色，按 depends_on 串联执行并接力输出。让 OCTOP 从单 agent 升级为多专家协作。
description.en: From agency-orchestrator: turn one sentence into a dependency-ordered DAG, match each step to the best sub-agent role, and chain outputs via depends_on.

welcome_message.zh: 我是协作编排专家，给我一个目标，我把它拆给合适的专家去跑
welcome_message.en: I'm the orchestration expert — give me a goal and I'll decompose it across the right experts

description.zh: 把复杂目标编成有依赖的步骤
description.en: Turn a complex goal into ordered steps

prompt.zh: 请帮我把这个目标拆成有依赖关系的步骤，为每一步匹配最合适的子智能体角色（引用其 slug），写出 depends_on 与 output 接力，形成可执行的协作计划。
prompt.en: Decompose this goal into a dependency DAG, assign each step a sub-agent role, and chain outputs.

description.zh: 为持续项目锁定一组固定阵容
description.en: Lock a fixed roster for an ongoing project

prompt.zh: 这是一个持续项目，请为我锁定一组固定的子智能体阵容（如架构师、后端、前端、测试、运维），说明各自职责与协作顺序，便于反复复用。
prompt.en: Lock a reusable sub-agent roster for this ongoing project, with a role and order for each member.

description.zh: 标出哪些步骤可并行、哪些必须等待
description.en: Mark which steps can run in parallel

prompt.zh: 请给这份协作计划补上 depends_on：没有依赖的步骤标成可并行，有依赖的等上游完成再派发。计划如下：
prompt.en: Add depends_on to this collaboration plan: steps with no dependency can run in parallel; the rest wait for upstream output.

description.zh: 让下一步直接用上一步的结果
description.en: Feed each step the previous output

prompt.zh: 请把这些步骤改成接力写法：每步命名 output，下一步用 {{上一步output}} 引用，避免重复生成。步骤如下：
prompt.en: Rewrite these steps so each one names an output and the next step references it, instead of regenerating the same work.

description.zh: 按依赖派给子智能体并汇总
description.en: Assign steps, then collect the results

prompt.zh: 请按这份 DAG 派发：无依赖的步骤并行交给对应子智能体，有依赖的等上游完成再派，最后汇总成一份交付。
prompt.en: Dispatch this DAG: run independent steps in parallel, wait on dependencies, then collect everything into one deliverable.

description.zh: 对外或不可逆步骤先给用户确认
description.en: Ask before irreversible or external steps

prompt.zh: 这份计划里有对外或不可逆步骤。请先标出哪些必须等我确认，再给出确认后的执行顺序。计划如下：
prompt.en: This plan has external or irreversible steps. Mark which ones need my confirmation, then give the execution order after I approve.

zh: 每个工作日「09:30」检查进行中的多专家协作计划，汇报卡在哪一步，任务创建后立即启用
每周五「17:00」汇总本周已完成的协作任务与遗留依赖
每天「18:00」若有未关闭的 DAG 步骤，提醒我确认是否继续或换角
en: Every weekday at 09:30, inspect in-flight multi-expert plans and report which step is blocked — enable immediately
Every Friday at 17:00, summarize completed collaboration tasks and leftover dependencies
Every day at 18:00, if any DAG step is still open, ask me whether to continue or reassign the role
